scope.intended_use: A supervised, low-speed, two-wheel single-axis FPV rover that actively balances as an inverted pendulum on firm level test surfaces.
scope.user_context: Adult hobby builder and supervised test operator; no autonomous, public-road, stair, human-carrying or unsupervised use.
variants: Pololu 4755 drive with BaneBots T81H-RM61 hubs and T81P-496BB wheels
out_of_scope: Safety, range, runtime or terrain claims

entities.name: printed structural frame and motor pods
protected 3S battery and logic power buses
firm level test surface and RF environment

drivers: INT=4: 18 mechanical, electrical, data, optical, human and environmental interfaces include dynamic and safety-relevant boundaries.
CPL=4: wheel geometry, mass properties, controller model, power integrity and landing envelope propagate changes across the system.
MOT/PHY/EXT/VER=4: active balance couples repeated motion, tire contact, electronics, firmware and a staged verification ladder.

blocking_unknowns: Delivered COTS revisions, tolerances and measured installed envelopes are not confirmed.
BaneBots hub engagement, set-screw registration and snap-ring retention on the Pololu shaft are not physically verified.
With the old axle-relative body unchanged, the 123.825 mm wheel projects an upright height of 251.4125 mm and therefore needs a bom.2 envelope correction to return below 250 mm.
Loaded tire radius, traction, wear and dynamic controller correlation are untested.
Exact Anycubic printer, process and filament JSON profiles are absent.
No restrained electrical, fault-injection, tip, cycle or supervised balance evidence exists.

criticality.rationale: A powered dynamically unstable rover with a LiPo battery can fall, shed a wheel, overheat or move unexpectedly; expert-in-the-loop staged tests and independent cutoff remain mandatory.
credible_failure_effects: loss of balance and damage to camera/electronics

decision.rationale: Dimensioned official COTS evidence raises the critical hardpoint interfaces to nominal R3, but the project remains R2 because the exact manufacturing profile and physical/dynamic verification are absent; G3 fails and K3 prohibits autonomous release.

warnings.message: Exact delivered variants and tolerances are not sample-confirmed; nominal manufacturer geometry is not a fit release.
Wheel retention, tire contact, printed pod creep, tip impacts and balance dynamics require staged physical tests.
The complete exact Anycubic machine/process/filament profile set is unavailable, so G3 fails and no 3MF/G-code is authorized.
K3 powered-vehicle scope requires expert review, controlled prototypes and a human-owned release decision.
Availability snapshots are volatile; the Gens ace manufacturer page is internally inconsistent and must be checked before ordering.
The selected wheel is 3.825 mm larger in diameter and 21.68 mm narrower than the bom.1 proxy; an unchanged body would project to 251.4125 mm upright height, above the 250 mm requirement.

next_actions.action: Procure and intake-measure one exact sample of every geometry-owning COTS item, beginning with the T81 wheel/hub and Pololu motor/bracket stack.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Part labels, revisions, mass, critical dimensions, tolerance/uncertainty and photos are recorded; all variant_confirmed fields for the selected drive stack can become true.

next_actions.action: Update the parametric wheel/hub proxies and printed motor-pod/clearance/roof geometry to bom.2, then rebuild the whole-system mass/COM and control model.
next_actions.exit_criterion: A fresh candidate is at most 250 mm tall and passes the interface graph, envelope, clearance, mass/COM, parameter-sweep and idealized-control checks against measured bom.2 inputs.

next_actions.action: Print only process-matched interface coupons after supplying a complete Anycubic profile set.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Motor bracket, battery, IMU, driver, camera, VTX and service-panel coupons pass documented fit criteria.

next_actions.action: Run expert-reviewed wheel-off-ground, restrained power, fault-injection, low-energy tip/cycle and finally supervised free-balance tests.
next_actions.exit_criterion: All interface acceptance criteria pass with logs and independent cutoff available; no release claim is made before human review.
